# HSV Range

Selects splats by colour range — for example all the greens of a lawn — with soft edges.

`lfs.hsv_range` · Selection

## How to use

Pick the hue, then widen Hue Range until the whole object is caught.  
Raise Saturation Min to ignore greys; raise Value Min to ignore shadows.  
Turn on Preview Selection to see the result in the viewport.  

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Hue | `Hue` | lfs.float | 0 | min 0; max 1; step 0.01 | Centre of the colour range on the colour wheel, 0–1: 0 red, 0.17 yellow, 0.33 green, 0.5 cyan, 0.67 blue, 0.83 magenta. |
| Hue Range | `Hue Range` | lfs.float | 0.1 | min 0; max 1; step 0.01 | How far either side of Hue still counts, 0–0.5 of the wheel. 0.07 catches one colour family. |
| Hue Softness | `Hue Softness` | lfs.float | 0 | min 0; step 0.01 | Fade outside the hue range, in turns of the colour wheel. 0, the default, gives a sharp hue boundary. |
| Saturation Min | `Saturation Min` | lfs.float | 0 | min 0; max 1; step 0.01 | Lowest colour strength included, 0–1. 0, the default, includes greys; raise it to exclude them. |
| Saturation Max | `Saturation Max` | lfs.float | 1 | min 0; max 1; step 0.01 | Highest colour strength included, 0–1. 1, the default, includes fully saturated colours. |
| Value Min | `Value Min` | lfs.float | 0 | min 0; max 1; step 0.01 | Lowest brightness included, 0–1. 0, the default, includes black; raise it to exclude shadows. |
| Value Max | `Value Max` | lfs.float | 1 | min 0; max 1; step 0.01 | Highest brightness included, 0–1. 1, the default, includes white; lower it to exclude highlights. |
| Softness | `Softness` | lfs.float | 0 | min 0; step 0.01 | Width of the soft transition. 0, the default, gives hard edges; larger values soften the selection. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Selection | `Selection` | lfs.float | — | — | Selection strength: 0 is unselected, 1 fully selected; values between them make soft transitions. |
